chapters.title: Welcome to Prompt Engineering 🎉
chapters.description: Discover the world of AI language models and why crafting the perfect prompt is your new superpower.

chapters.title: The Anatomy of a Prompt 🧬
chapters.description: Dissect a prompt into its core components and learn the blueprint for clear instructions.

chapters.title: Mastering Clarity & Specificity 🎯
chapters.description: Transform vague requests into laser‑focused prompts that deliver exactly what you need.

chapters.title: Power of Examples: Few‑Shot Prompting 🪄
chapters.description: Teach the AI by showing it what you want – from zero examples to a handful of perfect demonstrations.

chapters.title: Role‑Playing & Persona Patterns 🎭
chapters.description: Assign expert roles and craft personas that shape tone, depth, and style like a master director.

chapters.title: Chain‑of‑Thought & Reasoning 🧠
chapters.description: Unlock step‑by‑step reasoning to solve complex problems and get transparent, logical answers.

chapters.title: Iterative Refinement & Debugging 🔁
chapters.description: Learn the art of the prompt‑response loop: test, analyse, tweak, and repeat until perfection.

chapters.title: Controlling Format & Structure 📐
chapters.description: Command the AI to output tables, JSON, markdown – any format you need for your apps and workflows.

chapters.title: Advanced Techniques: Chaining & Meta‑Prompting ⛓️
chapters.description: Build complex pipelines by chaining prompts and create prompts that write better prompts.

chapters.title: Real‑World Applications & Best Practices 🌐
chapters.description: Apply everything to summarisation, translation, creative writing, coding, and learn the ethics of responsible prompting.
